name: Fix root EntityId type definition to resolve cascading compiler failures
description: Fix the root EntityId type union and helper in src/types.ts to resolve compiler errors across downstream consumers.

inputs.task_prompt: A breaking change in src/types.ts restricted EntityId strictly to { id: string, ns: string }, causing cascading compiler failures across src/repo.ts and src/service.ts which also pass string IDs. Update EntityId in src/types.ts to be string | { id: string, ns?: string } and provide parseEntityId(id: EntityId): { id: string, ns: string } that defaults ns to 'default'. Do not edit repo.ts or service.ts. All tests in test/cascading.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: EntityId in src/types.ts permits both string and object forms
parseEntityId normalizes any EntityId to { id, ns }
constraints: Do not modify src/repo.ts or src/service.ts
